gloss: number of scheduled services; number of flights

definitions.gloss: number of scheduled services; number of flights
definitions.explanation: How many scheduled runs a transport service operates over a given period — flights, ferry sailings, long-distance buses, or delivery rounds. Usually counted per day or per week.

examples.english: The number of flights has decreased.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}のあいだは{便数|びんすう}が{増|ふ}やされる。
examples.english: The number of services is increased during the summer.

examples.japanese: この{島|しま}へのフェリーは{一日|いちにち}の{便数|びんすう}が{少|すく}ないので、{早|はや}めに{予約|よやく}したほうがいい。
examples.english: The ferry to this island runs only a few times a day, so you should book early.

notes:
{便|びん} (scheduled service, flight) + {数|すう} (number). A practical word in travel and transport news, especially when services are being cut back or added.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {便数|びんすう}が{多|おお}い / {少|すく}ない: to have many / few services
- {便数|びんすう}を{増|ふ}やす: to increase the number of services
- {便数|びんすう}を{減|へ}らす: to cut services
- {一日|いちにち}の{便数|びんすう}: number of services per day

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {本数|ほんすう}: number of runs — the usual word for trains and buses
- {運行|うんこう}{回数|かいすう}: number of operations — more formal, used in official announcements
